supersedes: followup-v1 E9 dependency, edit onset grid and primary alarm calibration; E0-E8 results unchanged
hardware: Local RTX PRO 6000; reuse frozen GPU feature caches; statistical models on CPU
data_scope: Existing videos have informed design; all comparisons exploratory. No new independent dataset.

E8B.question: Does correctly shared estimated phase improve conditional appearance beyond pooled subspace and extra Fourier capacity?
E8B.candidate: C-22 style uniform fitting and no inference gate; selected AFTER E8, not a retroactive replacement of C-21

arms.residual: centered pooled PCA; exact equivalent under same sampling/rank/seed

arms.phase: framewise observation_angle with the same causal lag descriptor, no recursive prior

E8B.scramble: offset=(integer(first 13 hex digits of SHA256(canonical JSON [offset_seed,source_id]))+0.5)/2**52; source-constant, independent across sources; no test labels/length/futures
E8B.gauge_control: A single common offset with refitted mean is a coordinate reparameterization, not a negative control
E8B.refit: Refit Fourier mean and residual PCA for M1/M2/each M4; reuse M3 and M0 after equivalence checks. Recompute reference scales and threshold for every arm/readout.
E8B.fixed: Within fold/seed share FIT tracker, appearance channels, fit sampling, rank cap, and E8 seed-42 selected Fourier order/ridge. M0 is the nested zero-harmonic exception.
E8B.primary_contrast: M3 minus M0 on historical fold-0 macro AP with normal OOF FPR guardrail
mechanism_contrasts: M3 vs M4 averaged over five fixed offsets
E8B.normal_mse_scope: Reconstruction/compactness using current observation, not forecasting accuracy or phase ground truth

capacity_sensitivity.rank: min(64, min_arm(min_feature_dim_minus1, FIT_sample_count_minus2)) per scene/fold; keep exactly rank axes, disable variance truncation; refit and recalibrate both

screening.paired_CI: Report M3-M0 and M3-M4; a CI crossing zero is inconclusive
screening.interpretation: Historical gains do not constitute independent confirmation

normal_validation_sensitivity.selection: Per-arm normal validation mean reconstruction MSE, identical search budgets; refit residual PCA and recalibrate; report separately from frozen-hyperparameter primary.

E8B.feature_source: Existing verified stride2_seed42 cache; projection seed stays 42 for all model seeds

E9S.claim_scope: Detection of controlled edits to held-out normal recordings; not verified industrial faults or phase accuracy
E9S.feature_source: stride1 dense cache; edit full source-frame order THEN sample output timeline at stride2; derive normal FIT/validation/reference/threshold at same stride from dense cache and refit statistical models
E9S.period: Median actual full source-frame counts of weak normal FIT recording candidates; fix same T for stride 1/2 before phase predictions; not an annotated true cycle duration
E9S.rounding: floor(x+0.5), edit length at least 2 source frames

maps.freeze: prefix [0,o) + last observed index o-1 repeated L times + suffix [o,N)

E9S.online_input: Only output-time indices and current/past edited features; source map stays in evaluator; no state reset at edit

arms.P9: P4 with observation-only angles for progress and prior=transition_kernel(previous likelihood), without recursively accumulated posterior

E9S.difference: mean squared difference of the same FIT-PCA-whitened descriptors; low and high tails both anomalous; -log(max(min(1,2*min(smoothed_lower_CDF,smoothed_upper_CDF)),1/(n_ref+1))) per lag; maximum across valid lags
E9S.difference_CDF: lower=(count_less+0.5*count_equal+0.5)/(n+1); upper=1-lower; n is valid reference observations for that lag; missing-history lags contribute neutral 0, not artificial zero-motion measurements
E9S.AR1: Ridge prediction x_t from x_(t-2) on same FIT PCA; affine intercept unpenalized; ridge [0.01,0.1,1] normalized by training count, select normal validation MSE; upper-tail reference-calibrated prediction error

primary_calibration.alarm: per-arm q99 of max score over normal THRESHOLD windows of length D=round(0.2T)
primary_calibration.window_weights: Each threshold video has equal total mass; weighted empirical inverse-CDF q99 (smallest value with cumulative mass >= .99)
primary_calibration.alarm_rule: score > threshold; report actual normal-evaluation window alarm rate, never claim guaranteed 1%
primary_calibration.short_videos: No qualifying windows is recorded. Fewer than 2 threshold source videos => that scene/fold operating-point result unavailable, do not tune on eval
primary_calibration.secondary: Original frame-q99 operating point for comparability, clearly separate from primary
primary_calibration.normal_eval_windows: Report matched original [onset,onset+D) windows with the same source/case weights as event sensitivity; also report full fixed-grid normal-window alarm rate

secondary_metrics: frame FPR at each operating point
event hits after initial 32-frame transient for freeze/reverse/swap only where an edited interior remains
E9S.aggregation: Per source equal total case weight within scene/fold/type/severity; compute AUROC within fold, average folds by eligible-source count, then equal means over severities/types/scenes. Do not pool unnormalized scores from different fitted folds.
E9S.normal_FPR: Frame-weighted and video-mean by scene; thresholds applied separately per fold

negative_controls.identity_edit: Must exactly preserve input sequence and reproduce scores within recorded numerical tolerance
negative_controls.speed_map: m(t)=min(floor(speed*t),N-1) for integer t>=0 while floor(speed*t)<N; not labeled as verified normal operation
negative_controls.boundary_analysis: Separate initial lag-length transients from edited interiors; skip is a point transition with no interior, never invent sustained skip GT

screening.scene_direction: positive primary effect in >=3 of 4 scenes; report exceptions
screening.CI: Report paired intervals for all primary contrasts; broad/cross-zero intervals are inconclusive, not proof of absence
screening.normal_window_guardrail_scope: Both matched original windows and full fixed-grid normal windows; primary q99 fixed, no threshold chosen on evaluation data

E9S.auxiliary_conditional: C-22 addition is secondary only; never let E8B winner selection change primary P0-P9

transition_time_matching.note: At stride2 matches legacy kernel parameterization; keeps nominal variance and restart hazard per unit source time matched. Observation density and fitted statistics still differ.

E9S.alignment_scope: Template matching uses x and a causal lag difference, so P1 is not a purely static appearance control and does not use the recursively filtered phase.

uncertainty.unit: source file until recording groups verified
uncertainty.derivatives: All temporal edits, original windows, seeds and offset controls stay clustered by source; offsets/seeds are not extra independent videos
uncertainty.scope: Descriptive 95% percentile intervals conditional on fitted models. No familywise significance claim or recording-independence claim.

execution_order: E8B fold0 seed42 equivalence and all-arm pilot
E8B all 5 folds and seeds42/43/44 without changing choices
E9S identity/causality/physical-lag checks and fold0 seed42 pilot
E9S all 5 folds seeds42/43/44, then stride1 seed42
E7 real-anchor validation and E9R real process-type evaluation when independent annotations exist
publication: Publish completed stage numeric artifacts, exclusions, frozen config, code hash and README tables/plots; planned artifacts are not results
historical_label_policy: Fold 0 only; strict-v1 excludes entire R02 testing 12/13/14 with label-length mismatch
